title: Good for an elf house
text: Good for an elf house. Tiny shelves! Not worth the space. Picture and description are VERY misleading!! A pencil is small enough to fit in these.  Very disappointed

product_metadata.title: BAMFOX Floating Shelves Wall Mounted Set of 3, Rustic Bamboo Wall Storage Shelves for Bedroom, Living Room, Bathroom, Kitchen, Office and More … (Mocha Small Medium Large, Width 4.1)
features: 【Natural wooden】BAMFOX's natural wooden wall frame uses only high-quality wood, which is strong and light. The surface of the carbonized pine wood is painted, so that the texture and color of each wood board are different to meet your unique needs. May this wooden wall shelf add beauty to your simple wall.

【Triangle Bracket】Triangle is the most stable structure. BAMFOX's triangle bracket adopts a one-piece 90° right-angled triangle design and is made of high-quality steel, which is strong, stable, and load-bearing. The surface of the bracket is painted, round, smooth, and flawless. We insist on using the simplest design to achieve the greatest load-bearing capacity.

【Reasonable storage space】Dimensions:9.06*4.13*0.47in(S)，12.99*4.13*0.47in(M) ，16.9*4.13*0.47in(L). After an investigation and trial, we decided to use the above sizes to meet diverse needs. This set of 3 wall-mounted storage racks uses natural wood planks of different sizes to provide a unique storage method for various styles of home.

【Multi-function and multi-scene】 The spacious and simple wooden wall frame is perfect for various scenes. Installed in the living room, so that the wall next to the TV is no longer lonely, perfect for storing game discs and various DVDs. Installed in the bathroom, you can use the cup and toothbrush as soon as you raise your hand, or simply decorate with scented candles.

【Wall storage】The spacious wall shelf can make full use of the wall space and is a favorite for small apartments. Make good use of the wall and keep the balance between the wall storage and the placement of the cabinets to create a neat sense of space and create a comfortable atmosphere.
